explanation: I searched Mathlib for lemmas that give Mono from a zero kernel. The nearest are Preadditive.mono_of_kernel_zero, Preadditive.mono_of_isZero_kernel' and Abelian.mono_of_kernel_ι_eq_zero. All of them need a Preadditive or Abelian structure. The theorem here only assumes HasZeroMorphisms, HasFiniteCoproducts, HasCokernels and IsNormalEpiCategory, so none of them applies as stated. The remaining hits (KernelPair.mono_of_*, Schur) are unrelated or depend on the preadditive lemmas. The only other uses of mono_of_zero_kernel are inside the same file.
